title: GARNIER charter review
subtitle: Review the proposed campaign; publication remains separately gated.
footer_text: Commissioned through Berthier. Agent-authored proposal; Stanley ratifies.

sections.title: Keep the codename GARNIER
sections.question: Keep the codename GARNIER?
sections.verdict: Use GARNIER as the working codename.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Rename it before ratification; update only GARNIER-owned references.

sections.title: Preserve the predecessor measurement boundary
sections.question: Preserve the predecessor measurement boundary?
sections.verdict: Plan and instrument now; preserve the predecessor evidence pack before publishing changes.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Authorize parallel work against a separately frozen predecessor tree, or explicitly make P5.2 ride a declared GARNIER baseline.

sections.title: Evolve the existing visual voice
sections.question: Evolve the existing visual voice?
sections.verdict: Evolve and enforce the five-slot Ghibli-pixel program under ADR-053 and the ADR-059 token choice.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Commission a separately scoped design spike before adopting a new voice.

sections.title: Constrain generated imagery
sections.question: Constrain generated imagery?
sections.verdict: If used, permit abstract-only generated imagery governed by VisualDNA, with provenance and alt consequences.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Use no generated imagery; reuse cleared assets or code-native diagrams.

sections.title: Serve funders through evidence
sections.question: Serve funders through evidence?
sections.verdict: Use people, lineage, operational state and contribution surfaces; no dedicated investors page.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Propose one funder evidence page within the existing navigation cap.

sections.title: Use three human reader classes
sections.question: Use three human reader classes?
sections.verdict: Operator recruits at least five engineers, five funders and five scientists; ≥80% correct per class in each test window.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Fold recruitment into the HAUSSMANN panel process with explicitly separate tasks, evidence identity and ownership.

sections.title: Keep the tier enum unchanged
sections.question: Keep the tier enum unchanged?
sections.verdict: Use executor_tier opus and additive executor_runtime codex; no enum extension.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Request a proposed ADR before extending the governed enum.

sections.title: Keep setup local and pinned
sections.question: Keep setup local and pinned?
sections.verdict: Use local pinned tools and ignored raw evidence; no outward installs. Genesis installed no new package.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Permit no new installs; mark any unavailable future instrument unmeasured.

sections.title: Adopt the derived campaign envelope
sections.question: Adopt the derived campaign envelope?
sections.verdict: Propose 26 missions and 26 sessions, totaling 1,637 kT content-load; Decade 2 stays provisional until midpoint.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Cap the budget and explicitly remove or defer named missions; keep mandatory P6 closure.

sections.title: Adopt measured prose budgets
sections.question: Adopt measured prose budgets?
sections.verdict: Propose home 600, quickstart 900, explainer 500, community 500, about 450, commons 450 and network 550 words.
sections.analysis: Alternative and effect: Amend per-surface caps without removing disclosures, prerequisites or accessible explanation.

composite_question: Adopt Decade 1 and provisional Decade 2 with the decisions recorded above?

sitrep.gate_purpose: Ratify the 26-mission campaign after reviewing evidence limits.
sitrep.importance_reason: Sets scope, budget and human gates.
